chunks: And Hudhayfah ibn Mansur narrated from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام, who said:
The one who frees is the mawla, and the child affiliates himself with whomever he wishes.

key_terms.الْمَوْلَى: the patron or master connected through emancipation
key_terms.الْمُعْتِقُ: the one who frees or emancipates a slave

ai.seo_question: Who is considered the mawla of a freed slave, and whom may the child affiliate with?
ai.summary: This hadith states that the one who emancipates a slave is regarded as the mawla. It also indicates that the child may affiliate his lineage or association with whomever he wishes in this context, relating to the rulings of wala' and social affiliation.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3501 - Hudhayfah ibn Mansur narrated from Abu Abdullah (as), who said:
"The one who frees (a slave) is the mawla (master), and the child associates himself with whomever he wishes."
